code_style: AI-code. AI-generated attributed weak-current fit authority; no production source is configured.

publication.title: A measurement of the K+ to pi+ mu+ mu- decay

scope: The preferred negative ChPT p^6 vector-current fit, used at leading electromagnetic mixing order. This is not the photon-inclusive dilepton spectrum, a neutral-kaon fit, or a source/material prediction.

fit_uncertainties.note: Do not apply the fitted statistical correlation to the total rounded errors. The systematic/external covariance is not provided here.

explicit_conventions.pion_em_factor: 1 + z/rV^2, with the approximate rV^2=2.5 prescription in hep-ph/9808289. No measured uncertainty for this truncation is invented.
explicit_conventions.radiative_order: Born two-body mixing width from the radiatively unfolded W fit; no photon-inclusive rescaling.

photon_inclusive_measurement.use: Comparison only. Includes QED corrections and four-body radiation; never a Born normalization multiplier.

unqualified_terms: Non-electromagnetic scalar, axial and weak-Z amplitudes are not extracted by this component model.
No charge-asymmetry fit is supplied for K-; charge conjugation is an explicit approximation.
Parent flight, material attenuation, regeneration and secondary sources are separate.
The full HEPData tables were not numerically refitted in this qualification.
